THE WORKFLOW

From cutting list to factory floor in four steps

01

Upload

A PDF or CSV process sheet — heights, widths, quantities and colour codes, in the format factories already use. Or paste the rows.

PDF · CSV · Raw Rows
02

Plan virtually

Every unit is rebuilt in 3D from its own panels, in its own laminate. Check fronts, colours and lofts before a board is cut.

Real-time 3D · Laminate Match
03

Optimise

Guillotine nesting on 2440 × 1220 boards, grain-locked, saw kerf included. System 32 boring on every panel, exported to a CNC-ready DXF.

Grain-Lock · System 32 CNC
04

Read the savings

Boards ordered versus boards needed, offcut recovered, edge banding and cutting — then a numbered plan the floor can follow.

Accurate ₹ BOQ · Numbered Plan
WHO IT'S FOR

Built for precision across every department

Designers & Studios

Designers

Quote a wardrobe in minutes on real board counts instead of a 30% allowance. Send your fabricator a DXF, not a sketch.

  • Instant board-count quoting
  • Zero sketch misunderstandings
  • Live 3D client presentations
Modular Factories

Factories

A cutting map per sheet, a boring schedule per panel, edge-banding lengths per row. No draftsman between the order and the saw.

  • Numbered beam saw cutting maps
  • Exact System 32 boring coordinates
  • Pre-calculated edge-banding lengths
Enterprises & OEM

Enterprises

One costing rule for every dealer and every job. Every process sheet gets the same nesting, the same drilling, the same savings report.

  • Unified multi-store costing formula
  • Automated board savings audits
  • Seamless dealer-to-plant pipeline

Jobwork — Cutting and 2mm E/B

E/B code — 4S: all four edges · 2L: both long edges · 1L: one long edge · 1L1S: one long + one short · — : none. E/B Ft is banded running feet for that row.

65mm Plywood Laminate Frames

Panel & drilling schedule

System 32 boring. Hinge cup Ø35 at 22.5 mm from the hinge edge; shelf pins Ø5 on a 32 mm pitch, 37 mm in from front and back; runner fixings Ø5 at 37 mm from the front edge. Every hole below is exported on the DRILL layer of the DXF.

Sheet nesting

Guillotine-cut optimisation on 2440 × 1220 boards. Woodgrain laminates are locked to grain direction; plain and gloss may rotate.
